title: Management and integrity views as tabbed reports
scope: Move the management dashboard and integrity review under Reports with tabs (Workload, Timeliness, Evidence, Outcomes, Ledger assurance, Integrity), compact figure tiles and tables, within the page-length budget

acceptance.text: The supervisor management page (1.9 screens on 2026-11-08) and integrity page each fit the budget; every figure comes from the existing summary API, with small groups still combined (ADR-036)
Non-supervisors still cannot reach Reports, including by direct URL

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Updated Playwright tests on the fixture build

notes.text: Added 2026-11-08 from ADR-044 (one Vati Workspace identity and design system v2) after the user's UI review against Cloudflare's dashboard and Zoho Workplace.
